observed_catalog_structure: BMG Production Music: Electronic landing page links 15 curated playlists and an Albums tab; 8 playlist result pages and 2 album pages sampled.

Track metadata panels show GENRE, KEYWORDS, INSTRUMENTATION, KEY (optional), BPM, TEMPO (optional), RELEASE DATE; identity fields include album, code, composer, artist (optional), label and track number.

Genre, Keywords and Instrumentation are multi-valued lists with substantial semantic overlap; no separate Subgenre, Mood, Production, Vocal, Meter, Arrangement or Structure field was observed on sampled detail panels.
Search-result keyword suggestions, track versions, STEMS indicators and a SIMILAR TRACKS tab are exposed. Similarity metric was not published in inspected UI.
taxonomy_anomalies: Breakcore is an INSTRUMENTATION label on Get The Eff Outta Here; its GENRE includes Electronica and Glitch.
GENRE mixes musical styles with Corporate, Sports, Technology and other use cases. Instrumental and vocal types also appear in INSTRUMENTATION.
D&B, Dnb, Drum & Bass, Drum And Bass and Drum N Bass coexist as labels; the Electronic curated playlist is Drum n Bass in its heading and DRUM N BASS in rendered navigation.
Aggressive/Agressive and Synthesizer/Synthetizer are preserved without silent correction.
Murmur: BPM 85 and TEMPO SLOW; Black Sun Divide: BPM 88. No doubling or half-time interpretation is imposed.
TEMPO strings include SLOW, Medium, MEDIUM, Medium - Fast, Medium-Fast, Mid Tempo and Up Tempo. No global BPM-to-tempo thresholds demonstrated.
Andromeda detail album code is A4PMA0002; an album listing rendered A4PMA002.
No exact UK Garage / Bassline atomic label was observed. Uk Garage, Ukg and Bassline occur separately. Other compound curated labels do function as single navigation links.
access_limitations: Sync+ redirected from its root URL to /en-us/playlists and displayed a login screen; no existing authenticated catalog access was available. No sign-in or access-control bypass attempted.
BMG Production Music used public en-us UI. Dynamic loading, disabled controls and a later timed-out compound query limited reproducibility; no unobserved results are counted.
Current Sync+ versus Production Music taxonomy comparison remains unresolvable. Historical promotional evidence in existing repository files is a separate evidence layer.
research_notes: Harvest started 2026-09-09 and finalized 2026-09-10 UTC. Purposive sample, not a statistical catalog estimate or complete taxonomy enumeration.
17 detailed tracks from 16 collections. Rendered list rows are coverage only, not fully sampled track records.

occurrence_count counts distinct observed URLs per exact term; track_occurrence_count counts detailed metadata records; multiple fields on one page count once. Suggestion appearances do not imply track frequencies.
Canonical display preserves rendered text. Case-only variants may reflect CSS presentation; normalized values are convenience identifiers, not unique keys or asserted synonyms.

Analytical buckets, synonym families, co-occurrence support and candidate rankings are DERIVED. All terms remain observed strings with their original source fields. Null/empty dedicated fields report absence of observation, never unfinished placeholders.
GENRE does not expose a formal hierarchy. Curated Electronic-to-playlist links are observed navigation; genre/subgenre relationships beyond this remain hypotheses.
Repeated generic tags reached local saturation. Sampling then targeted low-tempo DnB, version labels, breakcore field placement, minimal underscore and UK Garage. Global saturation is not claimed.

No direct sampled track evidence establishes Neurofunk, Darkstep, Hardstep, Acid Techno or an explicit Liquid DnB genre tag. Liquid Drum And Bass is an observed album title. No absence-from-catalog conclusion follows.
No audio, lyrics, artwork or long catalog descriptions retained. Existing SYSOP/BACKUP counts are prior public repository evidence, not BMG track metadata or new Suno experiments.
Suno v6 is a requested future experimental target; no model availability, internal ontology, prompt-control efficacy or BMG/Suno shared taxonomy is asserted.
